# sqlpipe v2.0 Release Notes

## Breaking change: `name` field split

The `/v2/users` endpoint no longer returns a single `name` field. It now returns two fields: `first_name` and `last_name`.

Before you upgrade, update any client code that reads `name`. This code will fail after the upgrade, because the field no longer exists.

Migration steps:
1. Search your codebase for the `name` field from `/v2/users`.
2. Replace each reference with `first_name` and `last_name`.
3. Test your integration against the v2.0 API.

## New flag: `--incremental`

Use the `--incremental` flag to sync only new and changed rows. This flag skips a full table scan and reduces sync time for large tables.

## Faster Parquet writes

Parquet writes are 40% faster than in v1.0. This improvement applies to all Parquet output, with no config changes required.
